mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.pin_id, p.prev_pin_id, d.document_id, d.content_source, d.document_name, d.document_type, d.tenant_id, d.library_id, p.creator_id AS "creatorUserId", p.created_time AS "pinTime", 'EDIT' AS "permissions", d.space_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bt_dc_document_library lib WHERE lib.library_id = d.library_id AND lib.visibility_scope = 'PRIVATE' AND lib.is_builtin = 'T' AND lib.library_name = '我的文档' AND lib.status_cd = '00A' ) THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END AS "myDoc" FROM bt_dc_user_homepage_pin p JOIN bt_dc_document d ON p.target_id = d.document_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.space_id = #{spaceId} AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.target_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND p.status_cd = '00A' AND d.status_cd = '00A' AND d.space_id = #{spaceId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.prev_pin_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC, p.created_time ASC ) tmp WHERE 1=1 5

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.pin_id, p.prev_pin_id, l.library_id, l.library_name, l.library_icon, l.color, l.tenant_id, l.description, l.visibility_scope, l.space_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bt_dc_document WHERE library_id = l.library_id AND status_cd = #{statusCd}) AS "documentCount", (SELECT MAX(d.updated_time) FROM bt_dc_document d WHERE d.library_id = l.library_id AND d.status_cd = #{statusCd}) AS "lastUpdateTime", (SELECT d.updator_id FROM bt_dc_document d WHERE d.library_id = l.library_id AND d.status_cd = #{statusCd} AND d.updated_time = (SELECT MAX(d2.updated_time) FROM bt_dc_document d2 WHERE d2.library_id = l.library_id AND d2.status_cd = #{statusCd}) 1) AS "lastUpdaterUserId", p.created_time AS "pinTime" FROM bt_dc_user_homepage_pin p JOIN bt_dc_document_library l ON p.target_id = l.library_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.space_id = #{spaceId} AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.target_type = 'LIBRARY' AND p.status_cd = #{statusCd} AND l.space_id = #{spaceId} AND l.status_cd = #{statusCd} ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.prev_pin_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC, p.created_time ASC ) tmp WHERE 1=1 5

SELECT p.pin_id, p.prev_pin_id, k.knowledge_id AS "kbId", k.knowledge_name AS "kbName", k.knowledge_desc AS "description", k.color, k.tenant_id, k.kb_code, k.knowledge_icon, k.knowledge_type AS "kbType", k.space_id, k.tenant_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bt_dc_document WHERE knowledge_id = k.knowledge_id AND status_cd = #{statusCd}) AS "documentCount", p.created_time AS "pinTime", 'EDIT' AS "permissions" FROM bt_dc_user_homepage_pin p JOIN bt_knowledge_base k ON p.target_id = k.kb_code WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.space_id = #{spaceId} AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.target_type = 'KNOWLEDGE' AND k.status_cd = #{statusCd} AND k.space_id = #{spaceId} AND p.status_cd = #{statusCd} 5
SELECT pin_id FROM bt_dc_user_homepage_pin WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_type = #{targetType} AND status_cd = '00A' ORDER BY created_time DESC 1

mapper.select: SELECT l.library_id, l.library_name, l.space_id, l.tenant_id, (SELECT MAX(da.created_time) FROM bt_dc_document_activity da WHERE da.library_id = l.library_id AND da.status_cd = '00A' AND da.action_type IN ('CREATE', 'EDIT', 'UPLOAD')) AS "lastUpdateTime", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bt_dc_document WHERE library_id = l.library_id AND status_cd = #{statusCd}) AS "documentCount", l.access_count, (SELECT d.updator_id FROM bt_dc_document d WHERE d.library_id = l.library_id AND d.status_cd = #{statusCd} AND d.updated_time = (SELECT MAX(d2.updated_time) FROM bt_dc_document d2 WHERE d2.library_id = l.library_id AND d2.status_cd = #{statusCd}) 1) AS "lastUpdaterUserId", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bt_dc_document_activity da WHERE da.library_id = l.library_id AND da.user_id = #{userId} AND da.status_cd = '00A') AS "accessCount", (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(da.created_time), l.created_time) FROM bt_dc_document_activity da WHERE da.library_id = l.library_id AND da.user_id = #{userId} AND da.status_cd = '00A') AS "lastAccessTime", l.color, l.library_icon,l.created_time FROM bt_dc_document_library l WHERE l.status_cd = #{statusCd} AND l.library_name = '我的文档' AND l.owner_id = #{userId} AND l.space_id = #{spaceId} AND l.is_builtin = 'T' 1

SELECT pin_id, user_id, target_id, target_type, prev_pin_id, status_cd, creator_id, updator_id, created_time, updated_time, tenant_id FROM bt_dc_user_homepage_pin WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status_cd = '00A' AND (pin_id IN (#{pinId}, #{prevPinId}) OR prev_pin_id IN (#{pinId}, #{prevPinId}) OR prev_pin_id IS NULL)
